premerge_pr.body:
W010 builds a source-bound local physical graph from W009 effective regions: exact same-layer contacts, declared connector edges and complete components. Each connector retains its own provenance and side audits; insufficient enclosure is reported separately while the physical contact edge remains.

Independent plan/code review, PM receipt and a dedicated premerge review are complete with zero must-fix findings. Normal direct/readback inputs produce the independently checked 14 nodes, 8 connector edges, 6 components and 16 side audits; cut-islands remain disconnected and the via-enclosure witness keeps its edge plus an explicit violation. Public DTO/wire, source authentication and complete nested exception-chain checks are covered.

Validation: original Python 3.10/3.12 full suites each 1465 passed, typing48, new packages and two clean outside-source installs; independent premerge reran the full 1465 and typing48, plus geometry/provenance/exception checks. PM reran 50 targeted cases, direct/readback composition, typing48 and independent finite geometry checks. Final source/package/evidence identities match.

One P3 resource-summary wording suggestion is nonblocking: the four no-cache cases span 12.58–17.09 MB, not 15.47–17.09 MB. PM will record the clarification with integration evidence while preserving historical reports. Full technology coordinates, external body/FIN/device extraction, annotation and remaining rule/publication stages stay deferred. Final W010 acceptance follows main integration and combination verification.

Evidence: docs/tasks/W010/independent-premerge-review.md and docs/tasks/W010/pm-receipt.md.
